# PhysxTendonAttachmentAPI

One attachment of a spatial tendon on an articulation link, applied as PhysxTendonAttachmentAPI:<name>. The parser reads the local attachment point (scaled by the link's world scale), the parent link and the parent attachment's instance name for every attachment, root and leaf included.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **Multi-apply:** applied as `PhysxTendonAttachmentAPI:<instance>`; `<inst>` in a column name is the instance. Instances: any instance name.
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**

## What USD population writes

Every declared attribute of an applied instance is published at its resolved value; parentLink when authored.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `physxTendon:<inst>:gearing` | float32 | none | 1.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 1.0 | 1.0. Not read for a root attachment, whose gearing is always 1. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:localPos` | float32[3], POINT | length | (0, 0, 0) | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | (0, 0, 0) | The link origin. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:parentAttachment` | uint64, TOKEN_ID | none |  | not written | none | No parent attachment instance; with parentLink this attachment has no parent. |
| `physxTendon:<inst>:parentLink` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | No parent: valid only for the root. The first of several targets is used, with a warning. |

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxTendonAttachmentRootAPI`](PhysxTendonAttachmentRootAPI.md):** Auto-applies this API with the same name; the parser classifies the instance as the root.
- **[`PhysxTendonAttachmentLeafAPI`](PhysxTendonAttachmentLeafAPI.md):** Auto-applies this API with the same name; the parser classifies the instance as a leaf.
- **[`PhysicsRigidBodyAPI`](PhysicsRigidBodyAPI.md):** Attachments are read only on emitted bodies (articulation links).

## Notes

- Instance names are arbitrary (one per tendon), so the compiled cache declares every physxTendon:* column.
